title: Admin Chisel
body:
Unobtainable
The following content is not obtainable by any means.

Reason: This item is exclusive to Developers.

Description

The Admin Chisel is an admin tool obtainable only by using a Spawn Menu. Like the name implies, it's a tool used for ease of testing for chiseling. It has maxed out stats, capable of instantly shaving rocks and cutting metals, having no charge.

Appearance

The Admin Chisel is a typical looking chisel with a glossy pink headpiece and pearly white handle. Headpiece is pink in color with the default legacy foil material applied to it. Handle is colored pearly white, using the default legacy wood material.

It shares the same model with all the other Chisels.

Trivia

  • Like all the other admin tools, it too had an early texture with gigachad decal plastered over it.
  • The Admin Chisel as well as other admin tools are publicly usable in "Oaklands 100 Players", however this game is rarely unlocked by the developers.
